campaign.title: Resolve the coefficient-level reflection algebra before estimating the maximal kernel

conductor_policy.monitoring: Keep the prime 2, polar terms, actual scale/height profiles, and endpoint stars explicit; do not promote a local identity into global cancellation without an exact interface.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close only after blind algebra, analytic insertion, hostile mixed-prime controls, and conductor graph adjudication.

numerical_purpose: bounded falsification of finite prime-power or 2-adic identities
resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary sources only for a theorem applied to the exact ramified and polar eigenspace family.

campaign.promotion_policy: Promote coefficient identities only after mixed-prime and 2-adic checks; promote a bound only if actual profiles and maximal truncation remain present.

closing_assessment.main_result: The exact 2-adic reflection cocycle and matching-profile projection are proved. Only the joint antisymmetric residue vanishes; generic poles and both Mellin axes remain. High-2-adic tail control is conditional on an independently formalized pointwise kernel bound.
